vo: Fuel stabilizer? Part fourteen sixty-one usually isn't your rule.
She thinks the gas can rule covers her.
Since October nineteenth, CPSC doesn't count stabilizers as flammable liquid fuels in that rule.
So she checks which other rules apply.
Comment M and Z, we'll DM you the free CPSC finder.
caption:
Say a seller lists a fuel stabilizer and assumes the gas can rule covers it. Then she reads it.
16 CFR 1461.2 changed on October 19, 2026.
It now says CPSC does not read "flammable liquid fuels" in the portable fuel container definition to include fuel additives meant only to improve engine performance, clean engine parts, extend engine life or stabilize fuel.
Other rules can still apply, so she checks the product before she lists it.
Not sure which rules apply? Comment M&Z and we'll DM you the free CPSC Finder.

sources.claim: Fuel additives (e.g. stabilizers) are not 'flammable liquid fuels' under the PFC definition; amended Oct 19, 2026
sources.quote: (b) The Commission does not interpret the phrase “flammable liquid fuels” in the statutory definition of portable fuel container in paragraph (a) of this section to include fuel additives that are intended to be added to flammable liquid fuels for the sole purpose of improving engine performance, cleaning engine components, extending engine life, stabilizing fuel, preventing weather effects from fuel, or another purpose unrelated to creating heat or power. [88 FR 74346, Oct. 31, 2023, as amended at 91 FR 65969, Oct. 19, 2026]

a portable fuel container is defined in the PFCSA as any container or vessel (including any spout, cap, and other closure mechanism or component of such container or vessel or any retrofit or aftermarket spout or component intended or reasonably anticipated to be for use with such container)— (a)(1) Intended for flammable liquid fuels with a flash point less than 140 degrees Fahrenheit, including gasoline, kerosene, diesel, ethanol, methanol, denatured alcohol, or biofuels; (2) That is a consumer product with a capacity of 5 gallons or less;
